name: team-local
description: The team workflow on local Lemonade models only (Cline + provider lemonade, no cloud anywhere): GLM-4.7-Flash builds and plans, Devstral (another family) reviews, same-model rework for 3 rounds, then the fallback dev model Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP takes the task over on a sibling card (started at once); only when the fallback fails too does the card go to the orchestrator. All model picks (dev, QA, fallback) are PROVISIONAL until kanban bench calibrate picks them

dev.note: PROVISIONAL: Cline on the dev tier's pick (GLM-4.7-Flash)

qa.note: PROVISIONAL: Devstral, another family than the GLM dev model; qa.routes sends Mistral-built cards to GLM

plan.note: plans run on the dev tier's model in Cline's plan mode (--plan), so a plan card needs no model swap

fallback.note: PROVISIONAL fallback dev model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP, a third family) on the dev role's agent

routes.why: Mistral-built cards can't be reviewed by Devstral (same vendor): GLM-4.7-Flash reviews them

promptNotes.screenshotFallback: This QA model may not accept images (Lemonade's Devstral and GLM are text-only): never open .png/.jpg files; judge the visuals from the screenshot tool's text reports (status, console, outline) in report.txt and say in visual that you read the reports, not the images.

candidates.note: in use (provisional): the dev model, so a plan card needs no model swap and has GLM's 200K context for reading the codebase
candidate; 64K context as Lemonade loads it

plan.note: Plans run on roles.plan (the dev tier's model) in Cline's plan mode (--plan). Provisional like the dev pick.

fallback.note: Same structure as team: after reworkRounds FAILs, a QA stall, an unchanged rework or an unresolved conflict the fallback sibling starts at once (local runs cost 0). Outages are waited out and then go to the orchestrator: every model is on the same Lemonade server, so a fallback can't get around its outage.

dev.note: PROVISIONAL dev pick (2026-10-09, before calibration): tool-calling, a 30B-A3B MoE so it is fast on the one GPU, MLA attention so its KV cache is small (131072 context ≈ 7 GB), and already Cline's Lemonade default. The memory budget assumes Lemonade loads it at 131072 (its max is 202752)
candidate: coding + tool-calling labels, 131072 context; dense 24B, slower. Calibration v11 saw it answer with <run_commands> text instead of native tool calls
candidate: tool-calling + vision, but Lemonade loads it with a 65536 context (raise ctx_size in Lemonade before using it for dev work)
candidate, untested: a custom import with the tool-calling label and a 1M context (the KV cache at that size may not fit next to anything else)

qa.note: PROVISIONAL QA pick: another family (Mistral) than the GLM dev model, coding + tool-calling; text-only. A dense 24B with a large KV cache (160 KB/token), so the memory budget assumes Lemonade loads it at 65536, not its default 131072
candidate: the only vision model that is also strong at code, so it can look at screenshots; 65536 context
candidate: vision + tool-calling, small (12B) and 65536 context

senior.note: PROVISIONAL fallback dev model (escalate.to): a third family (Qwen), neither the GLM dev model nor the Devstral QA model, so its sibling is still reviewed by Devstral. Started without approval (local runs cost 0); the core never hands a task onto the card's own model and sends a fallback sibling that fails to the orchestrator, so the takeover happens once

dropped.why: a Lemonade collection (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B + Flux + Whisper + Kokoro) without the tool-calling label, so it is not in Cline's Lemonade list; route to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP-GGUF instead

tierRules.dev: Lemonade models with the tool-calling label; cost 0
tierRules.qa: a different vendor (model family) than the dev model
tierRules.senior: the fallback dev model: a family other than dev and QA

tierNotes.dev: Memory budget (one GPU: Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, 96 GB GPU-addressable of 125 GB RAM): dev + QA + fallback must stay resident side by side within 80 GB, leaving 16 GB headroom. Estimate at the contexts this kit assumes (weights = Lemonade's size; KV cache f16 from each model's config): GLM-4.7-Flash at 131072 = 16.3 + 7.1 (MLA, 54 KB/token) = 23.4 GB; Devstral-Small-2507 at 65536 = 13.3 + 10.7 (160 KB/token) = 24.0 GB; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B at 65536 = 22.1 + 1.3 (10 of 40 layers full attention, 20 KB/token) = 23.4 GB; plus ~1.5 GB compute buffers each: about 75 GB. At Lemonade's defaults (GLM 202752, Devstral 131072) it is about 90 GB, over the budget: set the contexts (lemonade load <model> --ctx-size <n> --llamacpp vulkan --save-options) and Lemonade's max_loaded_models to 3. kanban bench calibrate picks the final models
tierNotes.qa: requireDifferentVendor reads the family from the model id (GLM → zai, Devstral → mistral, Qwen → qwen, Gemma → google, DeepSeek → deepseek)

settings.why: Lemonade/llama.cpp ends Cline turns without the TaskComplete hook; only the turn detector in mode on ends them (report only logs), or every card sits running with an idle TUI

local models need recovery to act: a no-images rejection or an overflowing context is cleared (/clear) and resent, and a Lemonade outage (connection refused, /health down) is held and probed instead of escalated
recovery must not be switched off for this project
